llm.summary: This instruction-only skill is coherent for Douyin searching and script analysis, with disclosed browser/web use and no hidden code, persistence, or data mutation shown.

dimensions.detail: The stated capabilities—Douyin video search and legacy short-video script analysis—match the instructions and examples.

llm.guidance: This appears safe to use for Douyin searches if you are comfortable with the agent opening Douyin/search-engine pages and possibly using your existing Douyin login. Use a separate or logged-out browser profile for more privacy, and verify the package publisher/version if supply-chain provenance matters to you.

evidence.explanation: The skill directs the agent to browse Douyin and fetch search-result pages. This is the core purpose of the skill and is read-only, but users should expect web requests to Douyin and search engines.
evidence.snippet: Use the browser tool... Use `web_search`... Then for each result URL, use `web_fetch`

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use it for searches you are comfortable sending to external websites, and review returned links before relying on them.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Your search terms may be sent to Douyin and/or a search engine, and the agent may open and read Douyin pages to summarize results.

evidence.explanation: The preferred workflow may rely on the user's existing Douyin browser session. The artifacts do not show credential collection or account mutation, but the search may occur in an authenticated account context.
evidence.snippet: Works if the user has logged into Douyin in the browser profile.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: If you do not want your Douyin account context used, log out first or use a separate browser profile.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Douyin results may be personalized or accessible because you are logged in, even though the skill only describes reading search results.

evidence.explanation: This metadata differs from the registry context for the evaluated package, which lists a different owner ID, slug, and version. There is no executable code or install step, so this is a provenance note rather than a behavioral concern.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Confirm the publisher and version in ClawHub if provenance is important before installing.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The package identity/version information is inconsistent, which can make it harder to verify exactly who published this copy.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses disclosed browser/web tools for read-only search and has minor metadata inconsistency, with no hidden execution or persistence shown.

permission_boundary.summary: The skill may use an existing logged-in Douyin browser session, but no credential capture or account-changing behavior is shown.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No memory, inter-agent communication, broad local indexing, or sensitive data storage is shown in the provided artifacts.
